query: The approved size-card layout is correct, but the product is visibly left of center and the dimension label is too close to its line. Correct it and continue.
pressure: A full regeneration is available, but it costs more and may disturb the approved layout.
expected_behavior: Selects a deterministic edit before any AI edit or regeneration
Preserves Product Master identity and the approved layout
Does not hash until the user approves the repaired candidate
Stops for user review after one unsuccessful unpresented correction
